title: 第15章 剑峰第一破坏王
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
反正不管怎样，只要有她存在，管他什么主角打脸名场面，通通都得变成自己的装逼舞台。

    微生璃月像是随意路过新生堂一样，轻飘飘的过来，又轻飘飘的离开。

    除了教训那几个嘴碎的人，全程没将叶不凡放在眼里。

    相比于被针对，叶不凡觉得微生璃月这种无视他的行为更加侮辱人，似乎他就是一只卑微渺小的蝼蚁，连进入对方视线的资格都没有。

    “微、生、璃、月，总有一天我会让你跪下来跟我道歉。”叶不凡猩红着眼，暗暗在心里默念。

    从新生堂回到剑峰，已是晌午。

    与金丹期修士可以彻底辟谷不同，像微生璃月和濮阳明珠这样还在炼气期的弟子，仍需和普通人一样进食。

    想好好在小师妹面前刷一波好感的林不语马上就意识到这个问题，自告奋勇去宗门给普通弟子提供膳食的地方打了饭菜回来。

    看三师兄这么积极，微生璃月还以为这太虚宗是有什么好吃的，结果……人家端了一大盆馒头回到了月神殿。

    真的就只有馒头那种，一点其他配菜都没有。

    “三师兄，我们太虚宗吃的这么清淡吗？”濮阳明珠看着那盆馒头，眉头紧皱。

    虽然她自知家里条件比不上小师妹，但也是从小金尊玉贵长大的，哪里见过这种场面。

    “这倒也不是，这不是三师兄没钱吗？”

    林不语挠挠头，有些不好意思。

    他是真穷啊，宗里给筑基期修士发的辟谷丹，都被老头子拿去卖了，自己都只能去吃宗门食堂免费提供的大白馒头，但凡想吃点其他的，就只能去山里打野。

    可这剑峰上的野鸡野兔，早被他和大师兄抓光了。

    其他峰又禁止他们剑峰的人入内，林不语也没办法。

    听到又是没钱，微生璃月真的服了，从储物袋里掏出一百枚极品灵石丢过去：“喏，三师兄刚才在新生堂表现不错，这是奖励给你的，以后吃点好的吧！你等会儿带着天二过去一趟，弄点好吃的回来。”

    说着，微生璃月又扔一个储物袋过去给天二，她可不是压榨员工的黑心资本家，天一天二跟着她，总得吃点好的。

    手里突然多了100枚极品灵石，林不语欣喜若狂：灵石，是灵石，自从来到剑峰以后，他有多久没亲手碰过灵石了。
content_en:
Anyway, no matter what, as long as she exists, no matter what scenes the protagonist slaps in the face, they will all become a stage for her to show off.

Weisheng Liyue seemed to be passing by Xinsheng Hall casually, coming and leaving lightly.

Apart from lecturing those people who were gossiping, Ye Bufan was not taken seriously during the whole process.

Compared to being targeted, Ye Bufan felt that Wei Sheng Liyue's behavior of ignoring him was more insulting. It seemed that he was just a humble and insignificant ant, not even qualified to enter the other party's sight.

"Wei, Sheng, Li, Yue, one day I will make you kneel down and apologize to me." Ye Bufan's eyes were scarlet and he thought to himself silently.

It was already noon when we returned to Jianfeng from Xinshengtang.

Unlike Jindan stage monks who can completely escape from grains, disciples like Weisheng Liyue and Puyang Mingzhu who are still in the Qi refining stage still need to eat like ordinary people.

Lin Buyu, who wanted to gain a good impression in front of his junior sister, immediately realized this problem and volunteered to go to the place where the sect provided meals for ordinary disciples to get some food.

Seeing that the third senior brother was so active, Weisheng Liyue thought that Taixu Sect had something delicious to eat, but... he brought a large bowl of steamed buns back to the Moon Temple.

It's really just steamed buns, with no other side dishes.

"Third Senior Brother, does our Taixu Sect eat so lightly?" Puyang Mingzhu frowned as she looked at the pot of steamed buns.

Although she knew that her family's conditions were not as good as those of her junior sister, she had grown up in a noble family and had never seen such a scene.

"That's not true. Doesn't it mean that Third Senior Brother has no money?"

Lin Buyu scratched his head, feeling a little embarrassed.

He was really poor. All the Bigu Pills given to monks in the foundation-building period by the sect were sold by the old man. He could only eat the big white steamed buns provided for free in the sect canteen. If he wanted to eat something else, he could only go hunting in the mountains.

But he and his senior brother had already caught all the pheasants and rabbits on Sword Peak.

Other peaks prohibited people from their Jian Peak from entering, so Lin Buyu had no choice.

Hearing that he had no money again, Weisheng Liyue was really convinced. He took out a hundred top-quality spiritual stones from his storage bag and threw them over: "Here, Third Senior Brother did well in the Xinshengtang just now. This is a reward for you. Eat something good in the future! You can go there with Tianer later and get some delicious food back."

With that said, Wei Sheng Liyue threw another storage bag to Tian Er. She was not a black-hearted capitalist who exploited her employees. If Tian Er followed her, she had to eat something good.

Suddenly there were 100 top-grade spirit stones in his hand. Lin Buyu was ecstatic: Spirit stones are spirit stones. It has been a long time since he came to Jianfeng and touched a spirit stone with his own hands.
title_en: Chapter 15 Sword Peak’s No. 1 Destroyer King
